name: obsidian-vault-rag

scripts.install-plugin: npm run build && test -n "$VAULT" || { echo "Set VAULT to your vault path, e.g. VAULT=~/Notes npm run install-plugin"; exit 1; } && mkdir -p "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/vault-rag" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/vault-rag/"

description: Ask questions about your Obsidian vault. Local RAG with Ollama and Weaviate.
